start: Immediately before the first codex scoring subprocess is launched.
end: After every one of the 540 new judgements has been schema/coverage validated and persisted.
included: failed attempts, retry backoff, rate-limit waits
any recovery interruption after scoring begins
excluded: experiment and input preparation before first request
semantic review or supplementary model review calls
secondary_metrics: sum of scoring subprocess elapsed seconds, not parallel wall time
first valid attempt latency by trajectory
resume: UTC epoch difference across invocations; monotonic elapsed for subprocess calls. Timer does not reset on restart.
